@hugo, re: STOCKFLOW-123 - the design note for EOQ says: never suggest more than one year of demand. If pack-rounded EOQ > annual_demand, return round_to_pack(annual_demand, pack_size) instead. So for your gap of 1010 vs EOQ 30, if annual_demand < 1010, you'd cap at annual_demand rounded to pack. The 30 EOQ would be the per-order qty, not the total replenishment.
